Enterprise Master Data Governance Blueprint

Rohit's end-to-end framework for high-integrity master data lifecycles, preventive CRUD controls, and multi-entity S/4HANA harmonization.

Stage 01 · SAP MDG WebDynpro / Fiori / MESC / UNSPSC

Data Ingestion, Request & Cataloguing Standard

Core Objective: Standardized Ingestion & Input Sanitization

  • User initiates material creation / change request via self-service SAP MDG Fiori portal.
  • Enforcement of mandatory MESC / UNSPSC category trees to prevent free-text divergence.
  • Pre-validation of manufacturer part numbers (MPN), generic nomenclature, and attribute sets.
  • Initial search against existing repository to catch apparent duplicates before workflow launch.

Measurable Business Outcomes

  • Elimination of rogue cataloguing entries at point-of-entry
  • Standardized engineering descriptions using industry naming standards
Architecture Standard: Lean Digital Core & SAP MDG Best Practices
